The '''Golden Fire Blossom''' was a beautiful and infamously delicate [[Flower/Legends|flower]]. During the reign of the [[Eternal Empire]], an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Botanist/Legends|botanist]] engineered a more durable species of the flower. It was believed that the seeds would soon be in high demand.<ref name="Berry">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Bioanalysis|Seeds of Opportunity}}</ref>
